## Gold futures (GC=F) research summary, as of 2026-09-12

I couldn't open any pages directly because the proxy refused every fetch, so everything here comes from search-result snippets. The Sept. 11 closing price differs between sources by about $19. Anything dated after 2026-09-12 that came up in searches has been left out.

### 1. Resolution source
- 2026-09-12: I couldn't load the Yahoo Finance GC=F history page. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/GC=F/history/)
- 2026-09-11: Yahoo says GC=F was tracking **December** futures, which opened at $4,359.40, down 1.1% from Thursday's close. A quote taken at 1:43 PM EDT showed $4,351.30. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/gold-price-today-friday-september-11-2026-gold-opens-at-lowest-level-in-over-a-month-ahead-of-cpi-data-111016419.html)
- 2026-09-11: The reported closes disagree:
  - Investrade: settled at **$4,408.90**, up $1.60. [Investrade](https://investrade.com/market-review-september-11-2026/)
  - The Gold Forecast: closed at **about $4,390**, up $31.50 on the day and down $87.20 (about 2%) for the week. [Gold Forecast](https://thegoldforecast.com/gold/2026/gold-shrugs-hot-cpi-while-scoring-third-weekly-loss)
- So the most recent close was roughly **$4,390 to $4,409**.

### 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. The resolution date is 6 trading days after the last close.

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-11: August CPI rose 0.4% month over month and 3.4% year over year. Core CPI rose 0.3%, slightly above estimates. Gold still bounced, but couldn't get back above $4,400. [Gold Forecast](https://thegoldforecast.com/gold/2026/gold-shrugs-hot-cpi-while-scoring-third-weekly-loss); [Kitco](https://www.kitco.com/news/article/2026-09-11/wall-street-turns-bullish-gold-price-ahead-fed-main-street-clings-slim)
- 2026-09-11: CME FedWatch odds of a Fed **rate hike** on Sept. 15-16 rose to about 90%, up from 69.4% that morning. [USAGOLD](https://www.usagold.com/daily-precious-metals-market-report-september-11-2026/); [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/gold-price-today-friday-september-11-2026-gold-opens-at-lowest-level-in-over-a-month-ahead-of-cpi-data-111016419.html)
- 2026-09-11: That was gold's third weekly loss in a row. Gold had dipped below $4,350 as Treasury yields rose. Kitco's weekly survey found Wall Street analysts had turned **bullish**, while retail investors held only a slim bullish majority. I couldn't get the vote counts. [Kitco](https://www.kitco.com/news/article/2026-09-11/wall-street-turns-bullish-gold-price-ahead-fed-main-street-clings-slim)
- Around 2026-09-10/11: August PPI came in hot, up 0.4% for the month and 5.4% year over year. [goldsilver.com](https://goldsilver.com/industry-news/article/gold-price-outlook-september-2026/)
- 2026-08-31: Gold fell after US strikes on Iran, and bets on a Fed hike grew. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/gold-prices-today-monday-august-31-2026-gold-sinks-following-us-strikes-on-iran-123744944.html)
- 2026-08-28: Markets were waiting for a speech by Fed Chair Warsh. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/gold-prices-today-friday-august-28-2026-gold-steady-as-markets-prepare-for-warsh-speech-115654858.html)

### 4. Base rates and volatility
- 2026-08: The August high was $4,670.90 (Aug. 24) and the low was $4,026.50. One source puts the month-end close at about $4,431, up 8.5% for the month. Another source gave different figures. [goldpricetracker](https://goldpricetracker.com/history/2026-08/); [Barchart](https://www.barchart.com/stocks/quotes/GCQ26)
- 2026-06 (late): The LBMA fix bottomed near $3,994.50, about 27% below the January high. [SD Bullion](https://sdbullion.com/gold-prices-2026)
- 2026-01-28/29: Record high of about $5,595 to $5,608. Sources disagree on the exact figure. [ziromarket](https://www.ziromarket.com/blog/gold-price-all-time-high-2026-international-xau)
- Trend: gold rallied sharply in August, then fell about 6% from the Aug. 24 peak to the Sept. 11 close, over three straight down weeks.
- My own rough estimate, not from a source: if gold's annualized volatility is around 20 to 30%, a typical one-standard-deviation move over 6 trading days would be about 3 to 4.5%, or roughly ±$130 to $200 from $4,400. Weekly moves of about 2% have been common lately, for example the $87 drop last week.

### 5. Other forecasts
- Kalshi and Robinhood run daily gold contracts. Robinhood's Sept. 11 contracts referenced the **Oct-26** futures contract and had strikes from $4,300 to $4,450. [Robinhood](https://robinhood.com/us/en/prediction-markets/metals/events/gold-price-september-11-2026-sep-11-2026/)
- I couldn't find Sept. 22 contract prices from on or before Sept. 12, and I found no Polymarket or Manifold market.
- 2026: JP Morgan's year-end gold target has been reported as $6,000 to $6,300, but only by secondary sources. [AOL](https://www.aol.com/articles/jp-morgan-predicts-gold-price-232746253.html)

### 6. Upcoming events before Sept. 22
- **2026-09-15/16: FOMC meeting.** A hike is about 90% priced in. The statement, the dot plot and Warsh's press conference are the main risks for gold. [goldsilver.com](https://goldsilver.com/industry-news/article/gold-price-outlook-september-2026/)
- The Middle East conflict involving Iran could add a safe-haven bid or cause sharp swings.
- Contract roll: Yahoo already has GC=F on the December contract, so the October expiry probably won't cause a jump. Still worth checking that GC=F hasn't changed contracts. [Barchart expirations](https://www.barchart.com/futures/futures-expirations/metals)
- Other drivers to watch: the dollar and Treasury yields, ETF flows, and central-bank buying.
